build_config_model_from_function: build a pydantic config model from a function using helpers.to_config_model for caching and reproducibility
create_config_with_infra: create a cached config from a function and kwargs using helpers.to_config with an infra folder
test_function_with_infra_decorator: test a function wrapped with helpers.with_infra decorator for pickling and result caching
validate_kwargs_against_signature: validate keyword arguments against a function signature using helpers.validate_kwargs to catch missing or extra params
find_slurm_job_by_id: find a SLURM job by its ID in a cache folder using helpers.find_slurm_job and read its config and stdout
